requirements.requirement: Board inside can breathe / electronics use implied
requirements.evidence: Enclosure is hollow single-cell volume (~166×144 mm top, 152×132 mm internal cover area) with louvre providing airflow path. No specific PCB/board prop exists in catalog to place inside; staged with cable-coil on top cover (prop:1) to indicate electronics use. Vent function is met by louvre hardware.

finish.summary: Single-cell closed hex enclosure built from full base with top+bottom covers and 6 solid caps, with one hex-port-louvre in side slot 0. Provides sealed box that still breathes through louvre. check_build ok, meshClash clear. Staged with cable coil on lid to show electronics purpose.

events.text: Your vented electronics box is up next — I'll shape a sealed enclosure that still breathes.

result.note: Ask again with a family or a few words (text) to see the parts themselves.

No place on the build takes this part right now. Change the build so it can (for example add the cells it needs beside or below it), then ask again. Guessing raw ops for a part with no offers rarely works.

events.text: I've sketched the core of your breathing enclosure — now I'll make the walls airtight and fit that louvre.

parts.name: Port plug
parts.use: Blanks a side port you are not using, so a cell that is closed up looks finished and nothing gets in through a hole you left open.

parts.name: Port louvre
parts.use: Vents a closed cell without letting rain in, so a box that has to breathe can still stand outside.

parts.name: Port screen
parts.use: Passes air and keeps insects and debris out, so a cell can breathe through an opening that is still covered.

parts.name: Port hose barb
parts.use: Lands a hose on a cell, so water arrives and leaves through a spigot drawn for it rather than over an edge.

parts.name: Port cable plate
parts.use: Leads cable through a side port on finished holes, so wiring enters a closed cell through something drawn for it and each run has its own way in.
